Ravi: quick sync — we need an RBAC + audit plan for the base-image rebuild that covers hosted, dedicated, and air-gapped customers. main gaps: who can sign, how revocations propagate, and what we log.
Mira: yes. propose a canonical signer-service that mediates all sign requests. CI never holds raw signing keys, only a pipeline SA that calls signer-service. signer-service calls KMS/HSM.
Devon: agree. RBAC matrix: pipeline SA -> submit-to-signer (staging), release-group -> request-prod-sign, sec-admins -> key-rotate. signer-service runs a small policy engine to enforce environment boundaries.
Priya: audit requirements: every sign action must emit a structured event with these fields: image_digest, tag, sbom_sha256, builder_id, request_id, signer_key_id, approver_ids (if prod), and artifact_url. events should be immutable and retained per contract.
sec-bot: created ticket SSEC-9997 "signer-service + audit schema" https://issues.internal/SSEC-9997
Ravi: revocation story: revocation list = signed JSON blob with entries {key_id, revoked_at, reason, revocation_id}. verifiers subscribe to pubsub and also poll a signed store. for air-gapped fleets, provide a signed revocation bundle customers can import.
Mira: runtime verifier behavior: prod — fail-closed if revocation store unreachable; staging — fail-open with alert. verifiers should surface clear error codes: SIGNATURE_MISSING, SIGNATURE_INVALID, SBOM_MISMATCH, KEY_REVOKED, REVOCATION_FETCH_FAILED.
Devon: key rotation plan: promote new key with a time-window where both old+new accepted (grace_hours). after window, old key moves to revocation blob. every promotion requires n-of-m approvals logged in audit.
Priya: air-gap signing ceremony: choreography doc required. include chain-of-custody for USB/transfer, HSM serial recording, operator witness list, and an artifact manifest hashed+published to secure store. retention default = 3 years (configurable).
Ravi: forensics checklist: collect registry manifest, attestation predicate, signer-service logs, KMS audit entries, CI job logs, and operator custody record. scriptable collection preferred.
Mira: SBOM enforcement: prod requires attestation predicate to include sbom_sha256 that matches registry SBOM. mismatch blocks deploy and raises P1 if it appears after rollout. staging optional.
Devon: implement revocation propagation test in staging: simulate compromise, publish revocation, measure time-to-reject across 3 verifier pools. acceptance: <5 minutes and alerts fire.
Priya: ops note — registry must support OCI attestations. validate artifact-registry retention and who can delete signatures. also add metric dimensions: verifier_result, key_id, env, image_repo.
Ravi: next steps: Devon -> PR for signer-service API + RBAC table, Mira -> audit schema and verifier error codes, Priya -> air-gap ceremony checklist + retention defaults. reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
